standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that the constructible topology of a spectral space is Hausdorff and quasi-compact, and that a closed subset of a quasi-compact space is quasi-compact
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 5244-5247)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives quasi-compactness of an intersection of constructible subsets.

standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that a constructible subset meeting the closure of an irreducible subset contains an open of it
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 5258-5262)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces quasi-compact opens containing the subset.

core_obligations: (1) implies (2): an intersection of constructible sets is closed in the constructible topology, hence quasi-compact there and a fortiori in the given topology (proof lines 5243-5248)

(2) implies (3) and (3) implies the openness condition: taking the subset itself as the quasi-compact set is immediate, and conversely an open of the subset containing that set equals the subset, while points outside the subset can be separated from it by a quasi-compact open (proof lines 5249-5265)

Equivalence with (4) and (5) and the final assertions: the quasi-compact opens obtained form a cofiltered family describing the subset, whose limit is spectral with the stated properties (proof lines 5266-5282)
proof_roadmap: (1)⇒(2)：可构造集的交在可构造拓扑中闭 ⇒ 在可构造拓扑中准紧 ⇒ 在原拓扑中准紧。
(2)⇒(3)：取 E = W 即可；(3)⇒W 被准紧开集之交描述：对 x ∉ W，由 W 准紧可把 x 与 W 用准紧开集分开。
(4)(5) 的一致性把准紧开集排成余滤族，W = ∩U_i 且 W 是其极限 ⇒ W 谱，(b)(c) 随极限描述得到。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives five equivalent descriptions of the subsets of a spectral space which are themselves spectral via the induced topology, together with statements that such a subset is a limit of the quasi-compact opens containing it (author lemma at source lines 5221-5241, label lemma-make-spectral-space). The proof (source lines 5243-5283) runs the implications, using the constructible topology for the first, the separation of a point from a quasi-compact subset for the middle steps and the cofiltered limit description for the final assertions (proof lines 5243-5282). The separation step and the limit description are the substance. H3.
